messages:
noah: Noticing a small but customer-facing bump in 502s for /api/generate in eu-west1 since ~23:52 UTC. Narrow root cause -> header parsing for unusually long device strings. Pushed tiny guard (sha: c2d9f8). Can we fast-track in tonight's 00:30-01:00 UTC window?

deploybot: Deploy request queued for redwood/api:hotfix-c2d9f8. Canary plan: 10% for 5m -> 100% if green. Reply +1 to approve.
rachel (eng-oncall): +1. Ran a quick staging smoke; response 200. No encoder warnings.
omar (sre): +1. I have rollback commands ready and will monitor LB 5xx and pod restarts.
rollback (image swap):
```bash
kubectl set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:main -n prod-eu && kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n prod-eu
```
rollback (undo):
```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n prod-eu --to-revision=310
```
sylvie (qa): Staging smoke passed. I'll watch p95, 5xx rate, and token errors during canary. Draft release note: https://docs.internal/release/c2d9f8-draft
deploybot: Scheduled deploy 00:32 UTC. Canary started 00:33 UTC at 10% traffic. Metrics: https://console.redwood/metrics/prod-eu?job=canary
noah: Canary healthy at +4m, no 5xx delta, CPU/mem normal.
rachel: Promote to 100% at +6m if still clean. :thumbsup:
deploybot: Promoting to 100% traffic at 00:40 UTC... promotion complete.
omar: Dashboards green. No restarts.
sylvie: Final smoke passed. Published release note: "Hotfix c2d9f8: trim/normalize long headers to prevent intermittent 502s in EU."
noah: Thanks team  quick and smooth. If anything, use rollback above and ping #eng-oncall
